identity.explanation: The supplied official character page identifies Usopp as a One Piece character, and the supplied official Wano Country page establishes the requested story cutoff. The requested identity and continuity are therefore resolved. Adaptation-only material and non-canon material in the tactics page are excluded from the selected record.

claims.text: Usopp is a member of the Straw Hat Pirates and serves as their sniper.
Usopp is also known by the epithet “God” Usopp and has a stated bounty of 500 million berries on the supplied official character page.
Usopp is 19 years old, was born in Syrup Village in the East Blue, and his birthday is April 1.
Usopp’s father was a sniper in the Red-Haired Pirates, and Usopp inherited strong sniping ability from him.
Usopp’s defining combat style is long-range marksmanship, primarily using slingshots and ammunition with varied effects to confuse, disable, or attack opponents.
Usopp is skilled at deception, lies, bluffing, and psychological misdirection, and these traits can assist him in combat.
Usopp is highly dexterous and talented at inventing weapons and tools; before Franky joined the crew, he also handled ship repairs.

Usopp is generally cowardly and negative, but repeatedly gathers his courage to confront dangerous adventures and powerful enemies, gradually approaching his ideal of becoming a brave warrior of the sea.
After two years of training with Heracles on the Boin Archipelago, Usopp gained mastery of Pop Greens, seeds of hostile plants that grow extremely quickly and have combat and utility applications.
Usopp grows Pop Greens in a garden on the Thousand Sunny, so the supplied page states that his supply does not run out.

Usopp’s post-timeskip primary weapon is the Kuro Kabuto, a modified, portable black slingshot developed during the two-year timeskip. In its standard form it retains the design and functions of the previous Kabuto and can also be enlarged for close-range strikes.

Kuro Kabuto can transform into Grow Up Kuro Kabuto when supplied with water, because a living Bakun So plant inside it consumes the water. The enlarged carnivorous plant-like sling can consume rubble and use it as ammunition.
The technique Grow Up commands Kuro Kabuto to enter its stronger Grow Up form; the VIZ translation calls it Grown Up.

Totsugeki Ryuseigun, used with the Bakun So form, feeds nearby debris into the slingshot and fires a barrage of rocks and rubble. It was used with seastone handcuffs to defeat Buffalo and capture Caesar Clown.
Super Grow Up is a larger version of Grow Up that transforms Kuro Kabuto into Great Kuro Kabuto.
Bagworm is an extremely long-range incapacitation technique. Usopp uses three Kayaku Boshi as boosters to steer a payload-bearing projectile through the air before it opens over the target.
Usopp uses Pop Greens as Kuro Kabuto ammunition to create aggressive, restraining, explosive, sensory-disabling, defensive, and utility plants.
Midori Boshi: Devil creates a large Venus flytrap that can eat enemies and ensnare nearby targets with vines. Its saliva is acidic enough to corrode flooring and cause Ulti serious discomfort.
Midori Boshi: Sargasso creates resilient seaweed strong enough to delay an avalanche of rock and earth.
Midori Boshi: Rafflesia creates a flower that emits a foul odor capable of disabling enemies’ senses.
Midori Boshi: Take Jave-rin causes bamboo stalks to erupt from the ground and stab targets. Larger and stronger enemies can dent the bamboo, as Page One did.
Midori Boshi: Dokuro Bakuhatsu So explodes on impact in the shape of a red skull.
Midori Boshi: Humandrake activates when stepped on, causing humanoid plants to entangle a target and knock the target off balance.
Midori Boshi: Trampolia creates a flower-like launcher that throws anyone approaching it into the air.

Midori Boshi: Impact Wolf creates a wolf-shaped grass projectile whose nose releases a shockwave three meters in diameter. The shockwave was powerful enough to knock out Daruma while he was enhanced by Energy Steroids.
Midori Boshi: Boaty Banana creates a banana-shaped boat durable enough to withstand the boiling water of a Punk Hazard lake.
Midori Boshi: Uchiwa So creates tall fan-ended grass that Usopp used as oars with Boaty Banana.
Midori Boshi: Platanus Shuriken creates star-shaped cutting plants that fly at opponents like shuriken. Quick-reflexed enemies can parry them.
Midori Boshi: Nemuri So creates a flower that releases sleeping gas, putting nearby targets to sleep.
Midori Boshi: Hanabibana creates flowers that detonate in hot, bright explosions resembling fireworks; it was strong enough to throw Page One off Komachiyo.
Midori Boshi: Baku Bokkuri creates timed explosive pinecones. Page One resisted the explosion when Usopp attempted to finish him with it.
Midori Boshi: Sprinkler creates a flower that sprays water in every direction. During the Onigashima fire it could not produce enough water and was quickly consumed by the blaze.
Usopp can still use Fire Bird Star with Kuro Kabuto after the timeskip. Its post-timeskip use against Caesar Clown failed to ignite Caesar’s gases.
Usopp uses Bakusui Boshi, a pellet that releases powerful sleeping gas, to sedate the berserk children on Punk Hazard.
Usopp used seastone handcuffs against Caesar; the supplied page states that they neutralize Devil Fruit powers and can strangle an opponent with their chain.
Usopp can fire Tama’s kibi dangos as Kibidan Boshi at Gifters. The ammunition tames animals and people who have eaten successful SMILE fruits, making them subservient to Tama.
Usopp’s earlier named equipment includes the Ginga Pachinko and Kabuto, while Kuro Kabuto is the later post-timeskip slingshot supported by the supplied evidence.
The supplied pages do not establish a Devil Fruit, Haki ability, bodily transformation, or supernatural transformation belonging to Usopp through the end of Wano Country.

The supplied official character page identifies Usopp as a sniper and describes his Pop Green capability, while the supplied tactics page provides the detailed named techniques, weapon forms, limitations, and weaknesses.
The Wano Country page confirms that the Straw Hat Pirates participated in the Onigashima raid and that the Wano Country arc concluded after Kaido and Big Mom were defeated and Wano regained peace.
